play.helpDigital: In Play together, set player or team names in New game. Draw a category and start the 25-second timer only when the music begins. After checking the card, each correct player chooses one free square in that category. Correction and Undo fix mistakes. On your own phone, use My board and mark your answers yourself.
play.helpTie: Five squares in a row, column or diagonal make Bingo. First finish everyone's answers and bonuses for the same round. If several players have Bingo, start a tie-break. Only tied players continue: judge each answer after the next song. One correct player wins, several correct players narrow the tie-break, and no correct answers means another round with the same contenders.
